pairs: The Lord also said to Moses:
Ingredere ad Pharaonem, et dices ad eum:
“Enter to Pharaoh, and you will say to him:
Dimitte populum meum, ut sacrificet mihi:
Release my people in order to sacrifice to me.
But if you are not willing to release them,
ecce ego percutiam omnes terminos tuos ranis,
behold, I will strike all your coasts with frogs.
And the river will seethe with frogs,
and into the houses of your servants
and into the remains of your foods.
et ad omnes servos tuos intrabunt ranæ.
and to all your servants, the frogs will enter.’”
And the Lord said to Moses:
Extende manum tuam super fluvios ac super rivos et paludes,
‘Extend your hand over the rivers, and also over the streams and the marshes,
et educ ranas super terram Ægypti.
and bring forth frogs over the land of Egypt.’”
Et extendit Aaron manum super aquas Ægypti,
And Aaron extended his hand over the waters of Egypt,
and covered the land of Egypt.
Fecerunt autem et malefici per incantationes suas similiter,
Then the sorcerers also, by their incantations, did similarly,
and they brought forth frogs upon the land of Egypt.
But Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron,
Orate Dominum ut auferat ranas a me
so as to take away the frogs from me and from my people.
And I will release the people,
et dimittam populum ut sacrificet Domino.
so as to sacrifice to the Lord.”
And Moses said to Pharaoh: “Appoint for me a time,
Constitue mihi quando deprecer pro te,
when I should petition on behalf of you,
et pro populo tuo, ut abigantur ranæ a te,
and your people, so that the frogs may be driven away from you,
and so that they may remain only in the river.”
“I will act according to your word,
ut scias quoniam non est sicut Dominus Deus noster.
so that you may know that there is no one like the Lord our God.
And the frogs will withdraw from you,
And they will remain only in the river.”
Egressique sunt Moyses et Aaron a Pharaone:
And Moses and Aaron departed from Pharaoh.
et clamavit Moyses ad Dominum pro sponsione ranarum quam condixerat Pharaoni.
And Moses cried out to the Lord on behalf of the promise that he had made to Pharaoh concerning the frogs.
And the Lord acted according to the word of Moses.
et mortuæ sunt ranæ de domibus,
And the frogs died out of the houses,
And they gathered them together into immense piles,
Videns autem Pharao quod data esset requies,
Then Pharaoh, seeing that relief had been provided,
and he did not listen to them,
just as the Lord had instructed.
And the Lord said to Moses:
and strike the dust of the earth.
et sint sciniphes in universa terra Ægypti.
And let there be stinging insects throughout the entire the land of Egypt.’”
and he struck the dust of the earth,
et facti sunt sciniphes in hominibus,
and there came stinging insects upon men
omnis pulvis terræ versus est in sciniphes per totam terram Ægypti.
All the dust of the earth was turned into stinging insects through all the land of Egypt.
And the sorcerers, with their incantations, did similarly,
in order to bring forth stinging insects,
erantque sciniphes tam in hominibus quam in jumentis.
And there were stinging insects, as much on men as on beasts.
And the sorcerers said to Pharaoh:
And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened,
et non audivit eos sicut præceperat Dominus.
and he did not listen to them, just as the Lord had instructed.
The Lord also said to Moses:
and stand in the sight of Pharaoh,
for he will go out to the waters.
And you will say to him:
Dimitte populum meum ut sacrificet mihi.
Release my people to sacrifice to me.
But if you will not release them,
behold, I will send upon you,
et implebuntur domus Ægyptiorum muscis diversi generis,
And the houses of the Egyptians will be filled with diverse kinds of flies,
et universa terra in qua fuerint.
as well as the whole land in which they will be.
Faciamque mirabilem in die illa terram Gessen,
And in that day, I will cause a miracle in the land of Goshen,
in qua populus meus est, ut non sint ibi muscæ:
where my people are, so that flies will not be there.
et scias quoniam ego Dominus in medio terræ.
And you will know that I am the Lord in the midst of the earth.
Ponamque divisionem inter populum meum et populum tuum:
And I will set a division between my people and your people.
Et venit musca gravissima in domos Pharaonis et servorum ejus,
And there came very grievous flies into the houses of Pharaoh and of his servants,
and into all the land of Egypt.
corruptaque est terra ab hujuscemodi muscis.
And the land was polluted, in this way, by the flies.
And Pharaoh called Moses and Aaron,
Ite et sacrificate Deo vestro in terra hac.
“Go and sacrifice to your God in this land.”
Non potest ita fieri: abominationes enim Ægyptiorum immolabimus Domino Deo nostro:
“It cannot be so. For we will immolate the abominations of the Egyptians to the Lord our God.
quod si mactaverimus ea quæ colunt Ægyptii coram eis,
For if we slaughter those things which the Egyptians worship,
in their presence, they will stone us.
Viam trium dierum pergemus in solitudinem:
We will sojourn three days’ journey into the wilderness.
And we will sacrifice to the Lord our God,
just as he has instructed us.”
Ego dimittam vos ut sacrificetis Domino Deo vestro in deserto:
“I will release you in order to sacrifice to the Lord your God in the desert.
Yet you may only go so far.
At ait Moyses: Egressus a te,
And Moses said: “After departing from you,
I will pray to the Lord.
And the flies will withdraw from Pharaoh,
Yet do not be willing to deceive any longer,
ut non dimittas populum sacrificare Domino.
so that you would not release the people to sacrifice to the Lord.”
And he acted according to his word.
And he took away the flies from Pharaoh,
There was not even one left behind.
And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened,
ita ut nec hac quidem vice dimitteret populum.
so that, even at this turn, he would not release the people.
